findings: Every one of 24 raw check values matches the frozen expected.json via canonical JSON serialization preserving boolean/integer distinctions. Duplicate JSON keys and nonstandard numbers are rejected by the independent reader.

The four mutant outcomes were separately derived from source and immutable snapshot facts: omitted alias stays at 1 instead of 2; omitted global binding and endpoint-node-only reuse return Right after the parent lineage loses binder 1; same numeric ID returns Right for a new Bad kind. Raw correct equals fresh and mutant differs in all four. Fresh uses the same toy semantics, not an independent Graph implementation.

Two complete total-tree interval lists independently recomputed without model import or functions: build ancestor paths, sort them in descending-label preorder, and derive ends from descendant cardinality. All coordinates match raw and frozen literals, not merely the final Boolean.

Sibling deletion: deleting node 5 changes binder 1 interval [5,9) to [4,8), queried node 2 start 8 to 7, but relation (1,2) remains True. Nonendpoint move: parent[2] changes 1->4; relation (1,3) changes True->False although endpoint direct binders remain 0 and 2.

Source inspection confirms copy carries an existing immutable Cell token without inspecting payload; equal assignments and tombstones get new tokens; canonicalized constructors are new while leaf payload origins may be copied. Dense unchanged returns current skeleton, not old snapshot by numeric ID.

Raw poison controls report zero touches for copy/equal-assignment, leaf canonicalization and early root error. Successful child facts neither certify a new edge nor publish a failed transaction. Unknown writes, foreign epochs and unsupported mode fail closed in the tested cases.
limitations: Finite symbolic Python model only. Not Graph.hs/Haskell execution, complete write/dependency certificate, real shadow, reusable production cache, allocation or CPU result.
Toy edge computes child kind BEFORE binder/ancestry. Real denseChild checks Gen/binder/dominance BEFORE kind; this model does not establish production error/demand order.
Total-tree controls do not refine the engine: the binding-global invalidation policy stays conservative. Relation tickets and production Euler/write capture are not implemented.
Trusted owner/write surface is conventional Python encapsulation; forged Cells/Snapshots, in-place payload mutation and concurrency are outside scope.

Poison is symbolic explicit forcing, not GHC bottom/asynchronous-exception/sharing equivalence. Raw Patricia route, nextId, full Gen/structural validation, Kind laziness and production canonicalization are not implemented.
